parameters.description: Read all open tasks (including assigned tasks) and sections in the shared Einkaufsliste. No inputs, no changes. Check complete=true before treating this as the full list.

Apply up to 25 shopping changes and verify them. Always read shopping_snapshot first. request_id: copy from shopping_snapshot and reuse only for exactly the same request. operations array: add {content,description,section,expected_candidates:[matching snapshot tasks]}; update {id,expected:snapshot task,content?,description?}; move {id,expected,section}; complete {id,expected}; merge {id:survivor,expected,duplicates:[{id,expected}]}. Section is its live name. Meaning/variants are your decision; never merge variants or invent speech. Check every result status; uncertain/partial/conflict is not success. Permanent deletion unsupported.
